title: Bioluminescent Abyss & Bathysphere
summary: An interactive Three.js deep-sea dive into a volcanic trench at 4,000 m with acoustic sonar pings, a giant squid, and drifting bioluminescence.
description: An interactive Three.js dive and 30-second short film following Bathysphere IV into a volcanic trench at 4,000 m. Trigger sonar returns to illuminate hydrothermal vents and a giant squid above the smokers, switch between exterior and cockpit cameras, and watch a siphonophore and pelagic rays drift past the viewport.
